description.text: Kinematics control submodel for KUKA KR210 L150 L. Provides motion commands and setpoints to the S7-1500T PLC. Part of the Isaac Digital Twin: S7-1500T <-> OPC UA <-> ROS2 <-> Isaac Sim (Yaskawa GP110 URDF). TIA Portal v17 project: PLC_IsaacSim_ROS2. Data block: MAIN_KUKA_KR210_L150_L. OPC UA endpoint: opc.tcp://111.111.111.10:4840 (namespace index 3).
Commands and motion setpoints. Written by HMI/SCADA/Digital Twin, read by the SCL logic.
Left robot instance. Maps to SCL prefix: MAIN_KUKA_KR210_L150_L.MainRobotLeft_*
Motion mode: TRUE = Auto routine, FALSE = Manual point-to-point (BOOL)
Motion velocity for MC_MoveDirectAbsolute calls (LReal) - mm/s
Target X coordinate for manual move (LReal)
Target Y coordinate for manual move (LReal)
Target Z coordinate for manual move (LReal)
Manual mode: enable motion to TargetX/Y/Z (BOOL)
Intermediate return/park position after stacking cycle [X,Y,Z,A]
Manual-mode trigger: move to maintenance position
Manual-mode trigger: move to home position
Auto-mode trigger: run left stacking routine
Auto-mode trigger: run right stacking routine
6-point sequence for left stacking station (StackingLeft_Points1..6, each Array[1..4] of LReal)
6-point sequence for right stacking station (StackingRight_Points1..6, each Array[1..4] of LReal)
Actual robot state read back from the S7-1500T PLC via OPC UA. Updated every PLC cycle. These values are consumed by the ROS2 bridge (plc_reader.py) and compared against Isaac Sim TF data.
Left robot instance. Maps to SCL prefix: MAIN_KUKA_KR210_L150_L.MainRobotLeft_*
Actual Cartesian TCP position [X,Y,Z,A] in mm/deg (Array[1..4] of LReal)
Actual joint angles [A1,A2,A3,A4] in degrees (Array[1..4] of LReal)
Includes $MAMES mastering offsets: A2=+90 deg, A3=-90 deg
Maintenance position setpoint read back [X,Y,Z,A] (Array[1..4] of LReal)
TRUE when the robot is currently executing a motion (BOOL)
TRUE when the E-Stop chain is active (BOOL)
Current PLC/robot error code (INT, 0 = no error)
Axis limit proximity flags [A1,A2,A3,A4] (Array[1..4] of LReal)
Dead-band / tolerance per axis [A1,A2,A3,A4] (Array[1..4] of LReal)
